rules: Agents APPEND features at the END, next id = max+1, only after a GitHub issue exists. Never delete, reorder, or reword an existing feature/step. Behavior change = new feature.
Only the orchestrator edits `passes`/`evidence` on existing features, at merge, after verifier PASS. Implementers never touch this file; verifier is read-only.
passes:true needs evidence '<sha> <date> <cmd>: <result>' and a green FULL `pytest -q`, not just `verify`. (browser) steps need loop.md check (d) or Playwright evidence.
New feature: passes:false, evidence:null, each step one falsifiable behavior (<=25 words) copied from the issue's criteria. Link the issue, never restate it. Details live in .loop/<id>/LOOP.md.
Keep it lean: no descriptions, no prose, `note` only for a fact an agent would otherwise miss (<=1 line). Only a human may condense shipped features into bigger ones.
Next work = first feature with passes:false whose depends_on are all passes:true. Then follow .claude/commands/loop.md.
Check after edit: python -m json.tool feature_list.json >/dev/null

features.title: RAG chat core: ingest, retrieve, SSE answer
features.verify: pytest -q tests/test_main.py tests/test_rag.py tests/test_chunk.py tests/test_embed.py tests/test_pdfextract.py tests/test_config.py tests/test_logging_utils.py tests/test_cli_logging.py
steps: POST /docs/upload + /ingest chunks, embeds, upserts to pgvector; dependency down returns classified error
POST /chat/start mints trace_id; missing question, bad model id, wrong method rejected
GET /chat/stream streams SSE; dependency down emits stream-error with no raw exception text
Rewrite-LLM failure falls back to raw question and turn completes
GET /health/live 200; /health/ready 503 when a dependency is not ok
One trace_id on every log line per turn/upload, no leak across requests, no prompt/answer text logged

features.title: Eval trace capture and review UI
steps: Completed turn writes exactly one Trace with rewrite/retrieve/generate steps, after stream ends, no added latency
Failure turns still write a Trace: rewrite not configured, rewrite fallback, empty retrieval, mid-stream generation error
GET /traces lists + empty state; /traces/{id} renders steps by step.type, escapes question, 404 on unknown
POST /traces/{id}/annotate persists status/note/tags and shows on reload; unknown id 404, bad status 400
Re-writing a Trace never clobbers its Annotation

features.title: Optional accounts: password + Google login (backend)
steps: POST /signup creates user without logging in; duplicate email conflicts; Google-only email rejected
POST /login good -> 200 + signed cookie (Secure unless APP_ENV=development); bad -> 401 no cookie; /logout clears
GET /me -> {user:null} for none/tampered/garbage/expired cookie, never 500; user object when logged in
get_current_user_optional never raises, even on DB failure; chat and health unchanged with auth wired
Auth routes mount only if auth store + settings given; missing SECRET_KEY raises ConfigError
Google: login redirects with state; callback rejects bad state and unverified email; links to same-email password user; off if GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID unset

features.title: Persisted Threads + login-time sync
steps: Logged-in turn persists a Thread across turns/devices; Anonymous turn writes none
GET /threads lists only own; messages stably ordered; DELETE soft-deletes; foreign/deleted/oversized id -> 404 on read and write
POST /threads/sync upserts idempotently, keeps order/content, rejects writes to unowned Threads
afterLogin() defined once in index.html; does sync then hydrate
(browser) login form POSTs /login; afterLogin() once on success, never on 401 (static + contract tests only)

features.title: Optional login UX: signup, dismissible modal, logout
steps: (browser) Anonymous load: no overlay/modal, chat input usable, header shows Sign in
(browser) One-line non-blocking hint that signing in saves Threads across devices
(browser) Sign in opens modal; X, Escape, backdrop click each close it, current Thread intact
(browser) Modal toggles Sign in / Create account in place; email + password only
(browser) Signup auto-logs-in (client POSTs /login after 201), runs afterLogin(), closes modal, header shows email, no reload
(browser) Sign-in success runs afterLogin(), closes modal; wrong credentials: inline error, modal open, email kept
(browser) Duplicate email, Google-only email, invalid input each show a distinct inline message; modal stays open
(browser) Sign out POSTs /logout, header back to Sign in, server Threads hidden, client Threads shown
(browser) Valid session shows logged-in header on load; expired session or failing /me leaves app usable as Anonymous
(browser) Modal traps focus; header and modal fit 375px width
Playwright suite on a real instance covers load, signup, sign-out, sign-in, dismissal, inline errors, failing /me
No backend change: no app/*.py or schema diff; existing auth and thread tests pass unchanged
